title: Imperative And Sequence Technologies
description: Add imperative headless ordered side-effect engine and sequence canvas UI technology with playgrounds.
summary: Sequence playground now matches dag/flow styling and shell parity: Tailwind globals.css chain, favicons, package.json deps for sequence/play and imperative/play. SequencePlayController rewritten with full command surface (addStep, disconnectSteps, setSelection, reorganize, run, LOD, engagement), toolbar (Run + Reorganize + orientation), hierarchy/catalogue/inspection side panels, and window LOD/engagement measures. SequenceCanvas refactored to canvas-only + compiled/effect readouts with reorganize/runRequest/LOD/selection props. SequenceSession WASM extended with disconnectSteps, LOD APIs, setVelloThemeJson, sync_from_dag. Imperative catalogue JSON now includes input channel metadata; StepParamForm is catalogue-driven. Framework SequencePlayHost wired with panel definitions mirroring DagPlayHost.
